remarks: Welcome to 29 Abt Street. This two bedroom three bathroom ranch is situated on a quiet street that offers patio home style living without the HOA. Filled with natural light from generous windows throughout, this beautifully maintained home offers exceptional open living space and thoughtful updates throughout. Upon entering into the foyer, note the spacious eat-in kitchen with a breakfast bar and abundance of counter space to the left and the convenient first floor laundry to the right. Continue on to find the formal dining room that opens seamlessly into the oversized family room featuring cathedral ceilings, a bright skylight, a cozy gas fireplace and access to the back patio. This property features two generously sized bedrooms with the primary bedroom featuring vaulted ceilings, a walk-in closet and attached full bath. An additional full bath completes the main level of living space. Make your way to the finished lower level offering incredible flexibility, with a secondary kitchen, multiple versatile rooms, extensive storage, and a third full bathroom. Outside, enjoy a covered patio, ample green space, two convenient storage sheds, a two car attached garage and a double wide driveway. Updates include vinyl windows (most), luxury plank vinyl flooring, a newer roof and gutters (3 years). This home is move-in ready and a must see. Showings begin immediately.
